name: obs-settings-honored
description: outputTranscript and reportUsage in subagents.json are honored: the session starts with no notice.
setup: mkdir -p .pi && printf '%s' '{"workflowsEnabled": false, "schedulingEnabled": false, "worktreeIsolation": false, "outputTranscript": true, "reportUsage": true, "showCost": false}' > .pi/subagents.json
